title: GOAT Listing Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goat:listing
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by sku
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when GOAT listing data has stopped arriving for a given SKU.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per SKU and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures when one part of your GOAT listing feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
